verdict.rationale: The service's own pages say a publication or deposit (Veröffentlichung/Hinterlegung) in the Unternehmensregister can be submitted as an order through the Publikations-Plattform, and the Bilanz-Navigator guides disclosure filings. That is a filing transaction initiated online. The rest of the evidence describes searching and retrieving register entries rather than registering or forming a company. missing for 10: evidence that a founder can complete the commercial-register entry (company formation/registration) online, detail on the end-to-end online filing and payment flow, hands-on or independent corroboration.
